For Nigel · 30 September 2026

Navigation & range review

The menu structure and routes have been reviewed. Live range strength and full catalogue coverage still need Gallery’s product export.

Sample counts in this preview cannot establish whether a Gallery category is weak, discontinued or commercially viable.

Changes made

  • One Armchairs & Accent Chairs destination; the duplicate Occasional Chairs route removed.
  • Chests of Drawers has its own destination instead of linking to Cabinets.
  • Ceiling Lights is an aggregate of pendants, chandeliers and flush fittings, rather than a renamed pendant page.
  • Outdoor Wall Lights has its own route. Decorative lanterns belong under Home & Accessories.
  • Shapes, sizes, colours and art subjects remain available as filters instead of overlapping top-menu product categories.
  • Generic More, Collections and department-level New/In Stock links removed; New and Sale retain dedicated top-level entries.
  • Outdoor now has a dropdown. Made to Order has confirmed Upholstery and Mattresses entry points plus supplier information.

What Nigel needs to validate

  1. Active parent-SKU counts and replenishment status for every proposed product type. Count fabric/size variants under their parent product.
  2. Actual type assignments, primary category, image availability and stock status. Identify orphan SKUs and categories whose products all duplicate another range.
  3. Sales, margin, ongoing range intent and depth for small categories. Merge or move a weak range into a populated parent only after this review.
  4. Made to Order product assignments, available model families, fabric options and lead times. Upholstery and mattresses are verified broad ranges; finer subcategories remain unvalidated.
  5. Additional live types not evidenced in the supplied design: seasonal/Christmas ranges, smaller accessory types, specialist lighting and any expanded textile or outdoor range. Neither inclusion nor exclusion has been commercially confirmed.
  6. New and Sale assignments. No sample products are presented as genuinely new or discounted without these fields.

Evidence and limits

The supplied homepage and prior taxonomy establish the prototype detail. Gallery’s publicly accessible help pages confirm its main departments, Made to Order upholstery and Made to Order mattresses. The live storefront returned access errors during this review; no complete live category inventory or account stock export was obtained.

The product-type detail is therefore a proposed menu for discussion, not a certified reproduction of Gallery’s full current range.

  • Gallery catalogue departments
  • Gallery showroom departments, including mattresses
  • Made to Order upholstery and contract options
  • Made to Order mattresses and own-brand options
